reviews.x: These are the bomb they are easy to use and the lashes stay on all day

reviews.t: Super easy to use, and holds up to heavy wear
reviews.x: So I normally use a felt eyeliner pen to get my wings. I did all of my normal makeup and then used the magnetic eyeliner over just where the lashes needed to be. The eyeliner is thick and goes on very smooth. The lashes are way easier to place than traditional glued ones or the other top/bottom magnetic ones. I wore these out to an EDM club. it was sweltering and I was dancing nonstop. These lashes held up to headbanging, shuffling and being drenched with sweat from head to toe. I wish I got an

reviews.t: Others dont look as good work as well
reviews.x: I love these . So easy to use line flexable also . I bought diffrent product and so unhappy . The magnets came off in 3 times taking of . This one is the best and value also . Ladies try them . U won't be disappointed.

I will be returning, I hate leaving a negative review but these just do not work! The lashes are magnetic as they stuck to my metal tweezers but would not magnetize to the "eyeliner" Great concept but just not perfected!

I tried over an hour to shape these to my eyes and could not get these to stay on it even look good. Cut them down to fit better, but it didn't help. They look really fake and wouldn't stay on. Really not worth it.
These did not work at all! You can actually vuy the same ones on wish so that says alot
Does not work!  The eyelashes do not stay on with the eyeliner.  I tried applying both a thin and thick line.  Nothing worked.

reviews.t: Too long, needs lots of eyeliner, useful tweezers.
reviews.x: Strip is much too long and definitely needs to be trimmed which is tricky with the magnetic parts on the strip. Need to put a lot of the eyeliner on ( multiple layers) to create a strong enough magnetic pull to keep the lashes on. Definitely not a subtle or lash option and so further trimming of the actual lashes might be needed. Came with adhesive on the lashes to keep it on the plastic disk in the compact which warped the lash when pulled off. Tweezers definitely helped with placement.
Did not work for me at all...magnets did not stick well and the lashes were way too big and thick, wanted something more natural looking.
I don't know why but doesn't work for me I follow the instructions but don't work.

reviews.t: So much easier than the magnetic clip on type!
reviews.x: I love wearing false eyelashes, the longer and fuller, the better, but have never liked dealing with the adhesive and struggle sometimes with getting them on (the adhesive remover that close to my eyes kind of concerns me, as well). I was all on board when I saw they earlier clip on type magnetic lashes, but just can't for the life of me seem to apply the things so that they look right and aren't sliding down my lashes. Compared to these other application strategies, the magnetic eyeliner in thi

reviews.t: Good if you are good with lashes, unlike me
reviews.x: I ordered a version of the lashes that was way too much for me. I was able to use other magnetic lashes with the eyeliner. The tip of the eyeliner doesn’t make for sharp lines. But it was ok. I have a hard time with lashes in general, so I’ve yet to be successful enough to wear them in public. If I could get them on close enough to my lash line on both eyes, they’d be great  I’ve got a coworker who uses this product and her lashes look great- do I’m leaning towards operator error

I waited for over 8 weeks for my order when it finally arrived I couldn't believe it! As you can see in the picture one of the lashes are larger than the other and they are very chopped up. I was going to try to use them anyway because my grandsons wedding was the weekend that I received them. Low and behold the magnets wouldn't stick to the eyeliner!!! What a waste of money!!

DONT BUY! Complete waste of money. DIDN'T work AT ALL! I tried using different amounts of the eyeliner (thin & thick), different ways (wet & dry eyeliner), and the eyelashes would NEVER magnetically stick to the eyeliner! To top it off, the eyeliner creates such a mess all over the place that I had to clean up each time I tried to use them. What an utter failure of a product!

The only good thing about this product is the packaging. The lash tweezers were super cheap and poor quality. The eyeliner was THE WORST. It doesn’t go on smooth and forget about readjusting if you don’t get them on perfect the first time. If the lashes move all the eyeliner comes off with it. And the lashes are heavy from the magnets.

Absolutely love this idea and this product. Soon as I received it the package is beautiful. Lash little long had to trim them at the end was easy to do. Once I put them on I got so many compliments on them I'm definitely going to buy more of the Lash

Bought it to try out. The lashes that came with weren’t lashes I would typically wear but the magnetic liner worked with all other lashes. The bush for the liner could be better, it’s more like a nail polish brush rather than an eyeliner brush.

Packaging was nice.  Eyeliner is nice as long as you aren't planning to use it with the eyelashes.  This product does not do what it claims to do.  Eyelashes fall off within minutes.  You can't return because it's used.....rip off for real.

These eyelashes do not work there are not anything worth buying I should’ve returned them along time ago I gave them away and they wouldn’t work for them they gave them away they wouldn’t work for them either. Waste of money.

Ridiculous length unless you're doing drag. Threw mine in the trash, there was no way I was leaving my house in those things. They adhered well once the eyeliner dried which took a while.  Basically threw $20 in the trash.

reviews.t: That it works well for me!
reviews.x: I found that it was difficult for me.  I was confused as whether I was supposed to let the eyeliner dry before putting on the lashes or not.  I found they were one use only which I thought was too expensive for me.

Really wanted to love these but one they don’t stick to the liner . Two the lashes are WAY to wide for the eye( I have giant eyes). You can’t trim them because you will cut the magnets of the lash. So sad
they are very long you'll have to cut them down but you'll lose magnet depending on how big they are but other than that they are pretty nice they don't really stick that good but they are good.
Do not buy this they look like something for  Halloween the package is nice that’s it. Doesn’t work.im trying not to give any starts but I got to give a start before it let me submit
Ordered these and they do not 'snap' like they stated. Update: the key to make them'snap' is you have to use a generous amount... And make it wide! Overall, I would purchase again! 😊

claims.text: Many reviewers report the lashes do not stick to the magnetic eyeliner at all, even after trying thin and thick lines.
Several reviewers find the product easy to use and say the lashes stay on well.
Some reviewers say the lashes are too long, too big, or too thick and need trimming to fit.
A few reviewers complain the eyeliner is messy, doesn't go on smooth, or requires multiple layers.
Some reviewers consider the product a waste of money or not worth the price.
